|rulings=* Only adds power +3 during battle, not all the time.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Lightsaber%20Proficiency</ref>
* The character may add 1 to a Force drain and still be power +3 in a battle that same turn.
* The last sentence means that this Effect makes itself lost if the character is not carrying at least one lightsaber.
* A lightsaber carried by a character who cannot use it is inactive. An inactive lightsaber does not allow [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] to deploy, nor does it prevent [[Lightsaber Proficiency]]'s last sentence from making itself lost.
